To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the prostate cancer staging system, based on the TNM staging system, is inadequate for predicting the risk of prostate cancer-specific mortality in contemporary patients, 2) the current staging system should be revised to include information on prostate specific antigen (PSA) levels, Gleason grade and clinical stage to predict the risk of prostate specific mortality and 3) a nomogram based on these three factors can be used to predict the risk for prostate specific mortality.
The current staging system is inadequate to predict cancer-specific survival for all men with prostate cancer.
